ideas.pitch: An autonomous multi-agent system that ingests maintenance, security, and administrative grievances across the UEM campus, reasons over urgency and department jurisdiction, calls APIs to create Jira tickets, and dispatches SMS alerts to staff.
ideas.problem_statement: Agentic Harness Track: Build with AI agents going beyond simple chatbots, focusing on intelligent automation, tool-calling, workflows, and autonomous decision-making.
ideas.title: AgenticUEM Campus Dispatcher
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the Agentic Harness track using concrete multi-agent tool-calling workflows, heavily leaning on demonstrated autonomy similar to winning agent projects like BlackBox data agent.

ideas.pitch: A localized edge-ready mobile web tool for farmers in rural Rajasthan to snap crop leaf photos, run offline-capable computer vision models for disease detection, and trigger an agent to draft localized treatment schedules in Hindi.
ideas.problem_statement: Open Innovation Track: Build a solution to a real-world problem of your choice with the freedom to choose your own domain, problem statement, and technology stack.
ideas.title: AgriPulse Autonomous Crop Diagnostician
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines a high-impact local agricultural problem with robust computer vision and multilingual output, mirroring the winning recipe of localized healthcare and classification systems.

ideas.problem_statement: Agentic Harness Track: Build with AI agents, intelligent automation, tool-calling, workflows, autonomous decision-making, and agentic systems.
ideas.title: GraphGuard Autonomous Security Agent

ideas.problem_statement: Open Innovation Track: Build a solution to a real-world problem of your choice. Identify a meaningful problem and develop a technology-driven solution.
ideas.title: LocalAir Industrial Compliance Sentinel
